title: Pufferfish Eating Carrot
blurb: Violent, rhythmic and genuinely hypnotic. The crunch heard around the world. A pufferfish demolishing a carrot became an inexplicably legendary meme sound, mostly because the noise is far too large and far too regular for the creature producing it, and the video gives you nowhere to look away to. Use it for eating scenes, destruction montages, or as a straightforward attack on anybody with misophonia. Nobody has ever adequately explained why this is as funny as it is. It simply, reliably, is.
origin: From the viral video of a pufferfish loudly eating a carrot.
